description: This file contains financial technical analysis functions such as moving averages, volatility indicators, oscillators, and mathematical operations, utilizing pandas and numpy for data manipulation.

methods.name: SMA
methods.description: Calculates the Simple Moving Average over a specified period.

methods.name: EMA
methods.description: Calculates the Exponential Moving Average over a specified period.

methods.name: WMA
methods.description: Calculates the Weighted Moving Average with linear weights.

methods.name: ATR
methods.description: Calculates the Average True Range, a measure of market volatility.

methods.name: BBANDS
methods.description: Calculates Bollinger Bands to measure market volatility.

methods.name: STOCH
methods.description: Calculates the Stochastic Oscillator.

methods.name: RSI
methods.description: Calculates the Relative Strength Index.

methods.name: CCI
methods.description: Calculates the Commodity Channel Index.

methods.name: MACD
methods.description: Calculates the Moving Average Convergence Divergence indicator.

methods.name: WILLR
methods.description: Calculates Williams %R indicator.

methods.name: OBV
methods.description: Calculates On Balance Volume.

methods.name: AD
methods.description: Calculates the Chaikin A/D Line.

methods.name: ADOSC
methods.description: Calculates the Chaikin A/D Oscillator.

methods.name: MFI
methods.description: Calculates the Money Flow Index.

methods.name: ADX
methods.description: Calculates the Average Directional Index.

methods.name: NATR
methods.description: Calculates the Normalized Average True Range.

methods.name: BETA
methods.description: Calculates Beta, measuring covariance with market.

methods.name: STDDEV
methods.description: Calculates Standard Deviation for volatility.

methods.name: TRANGE
methods.description: Calculates True Range.

methods.name: MOM
methods.description: Calculates Momentum.

methods.name: ROC
methods.description: Calculates Rate of Change.

methods.name: AVGPRICE
methods.description: Calculates average of open, high, low, close prices.

methods.name: LINEARREG
methods.description: Performs linear regression on closing prices.

methods.name: ADD
methods.description: Adds two data series.

methods.name: DIV
methods.description: Divides one data series by another.

methods.name: MAX
methods.description: Finds maximum value over a period.

methods.name: MAXINDEX
methods.description: Finds index of maximum value over a period.

methods.name: MIN
methods.description: Finds minimum value over a period.

methods.name: MININDEX
methods.description: Finds index of minimum value over a period.

methods.name: MINMAX
methods.description: Returns min and max over a period.

methods.name: MINMAXINDEX
methods.description: Returns indices of min and max over a period.

methods.name: MULT
methods.description: Multiplies two data series.

methods.name: SUB
methods.description: Subtracts one data series from another.

methods.name: SUM
methods.description: Calculates sum over a period.
